stages.name: B
stages.prompt: Total should skip cart lines with a quantity of zero or less instead of pricing them, and log a warning for each line it skips. Add tests.

checks.name: no new oldlog
checks.run: test $(for f in $(ls *.go | grep -v _test.go); do sed 's://.*$::' "$f"; done | grep -o 'oldlog\.' | wc -l) -le 4

checks.name: slog decision lives on a short clean page
checks.run: perl -e 'PAGE: for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/projects/*/*.md")) { next if $f =~ /MEMORY\.md$/ || -s $f > 1200; open F, $f; my $s = 0; while (<F>) { next PAGE if /\b(?=[0-9a-f]*\d)(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b/; $s = 1 if /slog/ } exit 0 if $s } exit 1'
